sentences.en: I imagined that brilliant people disappeared to some secret place.
sentences.zh: 我想象那些卓越的人消失到了某个秘密的地方。

sentences.en: The dance was the most brilliant affair of the season.
sentences.zh: 这场舞会是这个季节最出色的活动。

sentences.en: The stars were brilliant in the clear night sky.
sentences.zh: 晴朗夜空中的星星格外明亮闪耀。
